benign_flow_noninferiority.rule: elastic benign retained-volume rate >= historical ThetaShield

feedback_is_exercised.rule: coverage policy must observe both eligible and deficit epochs

precision_preserved.rule: coverage policy inelastic mean FPR <= historical ThetaShield mean FPR

total_flow_noninferiority.rule: elastic total retained-volume rate >= historical ThetaShield

closed_loop.interpretation: The selected controller shifts part of the toxic-risk gain into bounded coverage feedback. It preserves the declared precision and retained-flow gates, but does not improve mean fee revenue in this deterministic synthetic experiment.
closed_loop.interpretation_boundary: Controlled deterministic synthetic evidence only; this is not live-market, profitability, deployment, or security-audit evidence.

hypotheses.fail_rule: the paired interval is below zero; overlap with zero is inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: Persistent-flow LP net PnL is compared pairwise against the fixed-fee result on identical streams.
hypotheses.pass_rule: paired 95% interval for ThetaShield minus fixed-fee LP net PnL is above zero
hypotheses.title: LP protection

hypotheses.fail_rule: a lower interval exceeds either limit; boundary overlap is inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: The benign-noise upper intervals are checked against fixed limits declared in the sweep manifest.
hypotheses.pass_rule: upper intervals stay within 10% of baseline mean fee and 5% false positives
hypotheses.title: Benign-flow fairness

hypotheses.fail_rule: the paired interval is non-positive; overlap with zero is inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: Positive values mean the full controller produced fewer false-positive premiums than raw markout.
hypotheses.pass_rule: paired 95% interval for raw-markout minus ThetaShield false-positive rate is above zero
hypotheses.title: Noise robustness

hypotheses.fail_rule: rank correlation is non-negative or fewer than two Pareto points exist; other results are inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: Lower false-positive rates are expected to accompany longer effective detection latency.
hypotheses.pass_rule: rank correlation is at most -0.35 with at least three Pareto points spanning 5 percentage points and 5 steps
hypotheses.title: Detection trade-off

hypotheses.fail_rule: either reduction is non-positive or retained coverage is below 25%; intermediate evidence is inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: The coverage floor prevents a controller that simply never reacts from being labeled manipulation-resistant.
hypotheses.pass_rule: ThetaShield reduces raw-markout false positives and oscillation with lower intervals above zero while retaining at least 50% toxic-premium coverage
hypotheses.title: Manipulation resistance

hypotheses.fail_rule: the advantage is non-positive or correlation is at least 0.95; intermediate evidence is inconclusive
hypotheses.interpretation: The volatility-only policy applies symmetric side fees, while this test requires a repeated-seed directional advantage.
hypotheses.pass_rule: ThetaShield's paired correct-direction advantage is at least 20 percentage points and mean volatility-fee correlation is at most 0.80
hypotheses.title: Directional discrimination

interpretation_boundary: This bundle is not live-market, profitability, deployment, security-audit, Circle-attestation, or Reactive-callback evidence.
